notes.title: NEW GAME RELEASE: The Testing Chamber - March 28th, 2022
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We wanted to let you know that we've finished development on our new title, The Testing Chamber.

The Testing Chamber is very similar to The Test Trilogy, however, it's also MUCH more advanced and offers a completely different style of gameplay and choice-making.

We urge you to add it to your Wishlist in the link below to be notified when it releases.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1921900/The_Testing_Chamber/

It will be available for purchase on March 28th, 2022 at 10:00 AM PST (6:00 PM GMT)

In the meantime, you can find our entire bundle in the link below if you wish to play our other games.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/Randumb_Studios_Deluxe_Bundle/

Thank you all so very much for your continued support! We appreciate you endlessly!

- Randumb Studios
